Home.title: Every coding agent. One shared surface.
Home.tagline: Run Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek, and ACP agents over the same projects — then give every one of them SuperOne's tools and collaboration layer.
Home.showcaseTitle: The actual product surfaces, not a marketing facsimile
Home.showcaseDescription: These previews come from the same reusable mock package as Storybook and the release media pipeline, including the latest realtime voice and cross-harness coordination flows.

hero.tagline: Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek and any ACP agent — one surface, one history, one set of tools. Each gains abilities its own CLI never shipped, and they can hand work to each other.

bento.heading: Four things make it more than a launcher
bento.subheading: Any agent can run in a terminal. Here is what changes when they all run here.

integrate.title: One surface, every agent
integrate.desc: Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek and any ACP agent share the same project, session history, credentials, MCP servers and skills. Switch engine per session — harness differences are declared as data, not branched at call sites.

extend.title: Abilities their CLI never shipped
extend.desc: Every harness inherits SuperOne's own tool surface: an embedded browser, computer use, iOS Simulator and Android control, image and video generation, interactive widgets.

collaborate.title: Agents that hand off to each other
collaborate.desc: Spawn a child session, hand off to a sibling, or link two into a shared mailbox — across harness boundaries. A Claude session can give a task to Codex and read the result back.

build.title: Apps that become agent tools
build.desc: Mini-apps pair a trusted Node host that owns computation with WebViews that own rendering. What you build becomes tools the agent can call.

rows.heading: Built for the way you actually work

collab.title: Watch a task cross the boundary
collab.desc: The coordinator view shows every spawned agent — which harness it runs on, which subtask it took, where it stands. Isolate any of them in its own git worktree so parallel work never collides.

voice.title: Talk to it, watch it work
voice.desc: Hold a realtime voice conversation with the agent. The transcript lands as a timeline while tools keep running in the background.

cta.title: Bring your next idea to the desktop
cta.subtitle: Free while in alpha. Updates ship automatically.

Download.title: Get SuperOne
Download.tagline: Free during alpha. Updates ship automatically as we cut new builds.

desktop.heading: Desktop
desktop.subheading: Signed and notarized builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

mobile.heading: Mobile
mobile.subheading: Mirror desktop sessions and drive your agent from a phone.

ios.title: iOS via TestFlight
ios.desc: Limited beta. Join the waitlist to receive a TestFlight invite when seats open up.

android.title: Android beta APK
android.desc: Side-loadable build with relay support. Auto-update is not wired in yet — sign up to get notified.

Download.footnote: Looking for changelogs or release notes? Check the docs site.

hub.title: The SuperOne handbook
hub.tagline: Browse every feature with a short demo, a beginner explanation, and the details power users care about. New here? Start with the four cards below.

harness.title: Pick an agent
harness.desc: Six engines share one surface — one click to switch.

miniapps.title: Grow your canvas
miniapps.desc: Mini-apps turn answers into reusable tools.

Changelog.title: Changelog
Changelog.tagline: Notes on what we shipped, why it matters, and where we're going next. Filtered for the things you'll actually notice.

Footer.tagline: A meta desktop app for AI-powered creation.

Demos.title: The current SuperOne interface, surface by surface
Demos.description: A categorized gallery of the desktop product states used by the website, Storybook, and release media. Change the brand color in the header to inspect every preview under the same scoped theme system.

workspace.title: Workspace and composer
workspace.description: The shared shell now exposes six harnesses, richer project state, and the same composer controls used by current desktop sessions.

conversation.title: Conversation and activity
conversation.description: Realtime voice, thread/timeline switching, temporary side chat, activity tabs, and compact completed-turn details.

coordination.title: Cross-harness coordination
coordination.description: Spawn, link, wait for, and hand work across different coding agents while keeping their progress visible in one conversation.

decisions.title: Human decisions
decisions.description: Permissions, structured questions, and plan approval keep consequential agent actions explicit and reviewable.

tools.title: Tools and execution
tools.description: Compact tool output, todo progress, current session controls, MCP discovery, and an embedded terminal share one visual language.

files.title: Files and previews
files.description: Repository state and rich file previews stay available alongside the conversation without leaving the desktop shell.

newSession.title: Six-harness new session
newSession.description: Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek, and ACP/Grok are first-class session targets in the current shell.

composer.title: Current session composer
composer.description: Slash commands, side chat, background-agent state, voice, model, permission, and sandbox controls compose in one input.

realtime.title: Realtime voice timeline
realtime.description: Codex voice sessions can move between the normal thread and a live chronological timeline.

activity.title: Unified activity panel
activity.description: Files, mini-apps, browser, terminal, trajectory, devices, and side chat use one closable and maximizable tab strip.

sideChat.title: Temporary side chat
sideChat.description: Focused follow-ups inherit the parent conversation, track their own context, and confirm before being discarded.

turnDetails.title: Completed-turn details
turnDetails.description: Prose stays readable while thinking, tool calls, and process output collapse behind one ordered disclosure.

collaboration.title: Cross-harness agent tree
collaboration.description: A coordinator can combine Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ACP, and other sessions without hiding ownership or status.

subagent.title: Background agent progress
subagent.description: Long-running delegated work reports its prompt, activity history, elapsed time, and token usage in place.

browserClose.title: Browser close results
browserClose.description: Compact tool rows distinguish complete, partial, streaming, and failed close operations.

permission.title: Tool permission
permission.description: Exact command context, rationale, and durable approval options remain visible before execution.

question.title: Structured user input
question.description: The agent can pause for a bounded choice with clear consequences instead of guessing.

plan.title: Plan review
plan.description: Review the intended approach and requested permissions before the session switches into execution.

toolBlocks.title: Tool output
toolBlocks.description: Edits, shell commands, searches, browser actions, MCP calls, and errors share a compact expandable format.

todo.title: Goal progress
todo.description: Completed, active, blocked, and pending work stays legible without taking over the conversation.

status.title: Session status and MCP
status.description: Worktree state, permissions, sandboxing, and connected tool servers are available directly beside the composer.

terminal.title: Embedded terminal
terminal.description: Shell output stays attached to the same project and session context as the agent conversation.

fileTree.title: Repository tree
fileTree.description: Expanded folders, selection, and Git state use the same dark sidebar treatment as the desktop app.

filePreview.title: Rich file preview
filePreview.description: Code, Markdown, images, and diffs render as activity surfaces without leaving the active conversation.

skills.desc: Pre-baked agent workflows you can run with one click.

miniapps.title: Mini-apps
miniapps.desc: Sandboxed apps the agent builds and runs inside SuperOne.

providers.title: Providers
providers.desc: Bring your own model — Claude, Codex, or a custom gateway.
